# DocForge evaluation results

<!-- Generated by `python -m evals report` from the files in evals/results/. Don't edit it by hand: rerun the command. -->

How well DocForge's three pipelines work, measured by the eval suite on its synthetic corpus, in every mode that has a committed result. Each column links to the result file its numbers come from. What a line means: [README](README.md). What each milestone found and why: [CHANGELOG](CHANGELOG.md).
